title: Versatile near-infrared polarization-sensitive ionic liquid-gated organic electrochemical phototransistor
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17580-17590
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01167A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jia Li, Xingyu Zhang, Min Guo, Xinmu Chen, Xiaolong Li, Zhidong Lou, Yanbing Hou, Feng Teng, Yufeng Hu
This study demonstrates polarization-sensitive organic electrochemical phototransistors with a photogenerated current dichroic ratio of 1.52. The devices show potential for neural synapse emulation and optoelectronic memory storage.
